scope: Built Electron renderer IPC bridge and local engine; real remote inference; not packaged-app or visual acceptance.
transport: Configured gateway; private base URL omitted; response bytes forwarded unchanged.
alias: Test-only loopback proxy replaces only the catalog request model ID with cx/gpt-6-astra. Catalog capabilities are unchanged.

image.prompt: Identify the background color and the center shape color in this image. Reply only with a JSON object with keys "background" and "center", using lowercase color names. Do not use tools.

criteria.catalog: Live models.dev entry declares reasoning and image input.
criteria.image: Public answer parses as JSON with background="blue" and center="red".
criteria.streaming: At least one nonempty text delta and one nonempty reasoning delta arrive through Electron IPC; matching persisted parts exist.
criteria.transport: Exactly one real upstream streamed request per attempt, requested model cx/gpt-6-astra; no generated response or altered capabilities.
criteria.completion: Engine returns idle without error within 120 seconds; no tools offered or invoked.
criteria.credentials: Key installed in main, never supplied to renderer; temporary credentials and history removed.
